proposition: Ibn Turka calls fellow lettrists ahl al-ḥarf, ramz-khwānān-i ḥurūf-i qurʾānī or arbāb-i ʿilm-i ḥurūf; Bisṭāmī likewise separates ḥarfiyya or ahl al-ḥarf (intellectual lettrists) from the messianic, incarnationist ḥurufiyya; MK follows Bisṭāmī in calling Fażl Allāh's followers Hurufis and Ibn Turka's circle lettrists.
